title: Improved Method for the Preparation of a Human Cell-based, Contact Model of the Blood-Brain Barrier
protocol: Coat tissue-culture vessels with "Attachment Factor" as per the manufacturer's instructions.
Maintain BECs in serum-containing complete medium.
Culture BECs in complete serum-free medium for experimentation.
Maintain cells in a humidified 5% CO2, 21% O2 incubator at 37°C.
Split confluent BECs at a ratio of 1:3 to 1:6 depending on the intended time for next use (3-7 days).
Change the maintenance medium every 3 days.
Use BECs up to 15 passages.
Culture SVG cells in minimum essential medium supplemented with components as specified.
Split confluent SVGs at a ratio of 1:5 to 1:10, depending on the intended time for next use (3-7 days).
Place tissue-culture inserts in the wells of the supplied 24-well plate.
Coat the luminal surface of the inserts overnight with rat collagen I in an incubator at 37°C.
Wash the inserts once from both sides with MQH2O to remove residual acid.

Invert the insert and gently fit around the rim of the porous membrane a short piece of elastic silicone tubing ("external tubing"; ~10 mm long, 8 mm internal diameter, 1.6 mm wall), creating essentially a new well above the abluminal surface (Figure 2A).

Prepare a plug made of a silicone tubing ("internal tubing"; ~8 mm long, 3.2 mm internal diameter, 1.6 mm wall) sealed at one end with a plastic sealing cone (~3mm long; prepared by cutting the bottom of a 0.2 ml PCR tube), which not only seals the internal tubing lumen but also widens its edge for tighter fitting into the insert.
Insert the silicone plug into the luminal cavity and advance it until it reaches up to ~1-2 mm from the membrane (Figure 2A).
Seed 4 x 10^4 SVG cells in 200 µl SVG maintenance medium directly into the silicone well above the abluminal membrane surface.
Allow SVGs to adhere for at least 4 hours in the incubator.
Transport assembled inserts between two 6-well plates to minimize exposure to unfiltered air during the procedure.
Wash silicone tubes and plugs in ethanol and autoclave for later use.
Use plugs only for inserts with membrane pore sizes larger than 1 µm.
Seed an identical volume of astrocyte cell-suspension into a standard 96-well plate to monitor adherence state.
When sufficient adherence is observed in the control 96-well, the astrocytes have adequately adhered to the insert membrane.
Transfer insert assemblies to the tissue culture hood.
Gently remove external silicone tubing and plugs.
Return inserts into supplied wells containing 800 μl/well of BEC maintenance medium.
Seed 2x10^4 BECs in 200 μl onto the collagen-coated luminal surface.
Return the inserts into the incubator.
Coculture SVG/BEC-seeded inserts for 3 days in BEC medium without media change before experimentation.
Wash cells by replacing abluminal and luminal media with 600 µl and 100 µl of serum-free BECs medium, respectively.
Aspirate the luminal medium again and replace with 100 μl of serum-free medium with stimulating agents.
If stimulation of the abluminal chamber is required, aspirate the abluminal medium and replace with 600 μl of serum free medium with stimulating agents.
Test each experimental group in triplicate.
Dilute reagents to their final concentrations in 350 µl of serum-free medium per group.
Perform standard paracellular permeability assays with labeled tracers.
Conduct transcellular permeability assays using FITC-conjugated albumin.
Measure TEER as previously described.
Analyze changes in permeability relative to a coated insert without cells.
Calculate permeability percentage using the provided formula.
Fix inserts with ice-cold 4% (w/v) paraformaldehyde in PBS for 20 min.
Wash once in PBS.
Submerge the insert in 0.1% Mayer's hematoxylin solution for 2 min.
Gently wash the insert with tap water.
Transfer the insert to Scott's tap water solution until the desired blue color develops.
Wash the insert again with tap water.
Air-dry the insert membrane.
Remove the membrane and mount it on a glass slide for bright-field imaging.
Fix inserts with ice-cold 4% (w/v) PFA in PBS for 20 min.
Wash inserts three times in PBS.
Post-fix membranes for 30 min in 1% (w/v) osmium tetroxide in MQH₂O.
Wash dehydrated inserts in water and dehydrate in an escalating ethanol gradient (50%, 70%, 90%) for 5 minutes each, then three times with 100% ethanol for 10 min per interval.
Treat dehydrated inserts with a mixture of hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS):ethanol (1:2 then 2:1) for 5 min.
Treat inserts with 100% HMDS for 5 min, air-dry and store under desiccated conditions.
Remove the membrane using a scalpel by cutting around the membrane edge.
Examine membranes by scanning electron microscopy.
Fix inserts with ice-cold 4% (w/v) PFA in PBS for 20 min.
Wash once in Tris-buffered saline (TBS).
Perform immunostaining of the cells on the insert membrane as previously described.
Remove the membrane using a scalpel by cutting around the membrane edge.
Mount the membrane on a glass slide with fluorescence mounting medium.
Examine the membrane by fluorescent microscopy.
